audience.audienceType: Study hall owners, Reading room operators, Multi-branch managers

mainEntity.name: What is study hall management software?

acceptedAnswer.text: It keeps student details, seats, shifts and fee records together so your team can manage daily work.

mainEntity.name: Can the same seat be used in different shifts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A seat can be assigned in compatible time slots, with checks for overlapping bookings.

mainEntity.name: Can I manage more than one study hall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Both plans support multiple branches, with each billable branch charged separately.

mainEntity.name: Can I give staff limited access?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Standard lets you invite staff and choose the work they can view or change.

heading: Manage your study hall in one place

audience.audienceType: Reading-room libraries, Membership libraries, Study libraries

mainEntity.name: What kind of library is Lab Lords for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lab Lords supports study libraries and reading rooms that manage student memberships, seats, shifts and fees.

mainEntity.name: Does it manage book lending?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Lab Lords manages students, seats, shifts and fees for study libraries. It does not manage book catalogues or lending.

mainEntity.name: Can I use my existing student list?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can enter students individually or use spreadsheet import. Review your information and resolve any flagged issues before confirming an import.

mainEntity.name: Can I manage several library branches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Both plans support multiple branches, and each billable branch is charged separately.

heading: Manage your library's students, seats and fees

schema.name: Lab Lords Seat management
schema.description: Manage physical seats and time-based allocations for study halls, reading rooms and study rooms without overlap conflicts.

audience.audienceType: Library owners, Front desk staff, Branch managers

mainEntity.name: Can one seat be used by different students?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in compatible shifts. Overlap checks prevent conflicting bookings for the same seat.

mainEntity.name: Can I set my own shift timings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Configure timings and fees to match your library, including supported combined shifts.

mainEntity.name: Can students book seats themselves?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lab Lords provides seat assignment tools for the owner and authorized staff. It does not offer public student self-booking.

mainEntity.name: Is seat management available in Basic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Seats, shifts and allocations are included in both Basic and Standard.

mainEntity.name: Does Lab Lords automatically charge students?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. These tools record and track student fees and received payments. Your Lab Lords subscription is billed separately.

mainEntity.name: Can I use different fees for different students?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Set a manual recurring fee or use a linked shift or combined-shift price.

mainEntity.name: Can I review unpaid and waived fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Payment records distinguish pending, paid and waived amounts.

mainEntity.name: Is fee management available in Basic?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Payments, dues and audit history are included in Basic and Standard.

schema.name: Lab Lords Fee reminder
schema.description: Identify overdue student fees and prepare owner-reviewed reminder messages for study halls, libraries, reading rooms and study rooms.

audience.audienceType: Owners handling dues, Fee collection teams, Branch managers

mainEntity.name: What does fee reminder software help with?

acceptedAnswer.text: It helps you find pending fees and check student payment history before preparing a reminder.

mainEntity.name: Does an AI draft send a message automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. AI assistance prepares message drafts for you to review. Creating a draft does not send it.

mainEntity.name: Does a reminder mean the student has paid?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Check money actually received and the payment record. Preparing or using a reminder does not confirm collection.

mainEntity.name: Which plan includes AI assistance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard includes AI reports and message drafting. Both plans include payments, dues and audit history.
